text: Look at the texture on this. It's micronized creatine, so it mixes right into your water instead of sitting at the bottom. This is Legends. Five grams in every scoop, and the scoop is right in the tub. No flavor, so it goes in your water, your shake, or your morning coffee. It supports strength, power and workout recovery. Skip the gummies. One scoop a day, rest days too. That's thirty scoops, so one tub covers your whole month. It's in the orange cart.
